Bench: Abhay S. Oka, Pankaj Mithal
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No(S).  Of 2023
 (@ Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No(S). 3242 Of 2023)
 Sharjil Khan Appe
 Versus
 The State Of Telangana & Ors.
..RES  ORDER 1. Leave granted.
2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

3. In paragraph 5 of the affidavit filed by Shri Dasari Balaiah S/o Dasari Sreepadam, who is the Regional Passport Officer, it is stated thus: -
5.

It is respectfully submitted that, should this Honble Court direct the issuance of the Passport in the present circumstances of the case, the Petitioners pending application before RPO, Hyderabad vide File No. HYE075332136723 dated 04.05.2023 can be processed further subject to any other requirements.
4. He has pointed out in the affidavit that if the passport is issued to the appellant on the basis of the said application, it will be valid for 10 years.
However, the learned counsel for the Passport Authority stated that if a criminal case is pending against the applicant, the passport can be of a lesser duration.

5. The apprehension expressed by the learned counsel appearing for respondent No. 5, who is the de-facto complainant, is that if a Anita Malhotra Date: 2023.10.20 15:43:19 IST Reason:
passport is issued to the appellant, he will leave India and go to Canada, where he has shifted his entire family.
6.

Since the prosecution for various offences including the offence punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, is pending against the appellant, it is obvious that without seeking permission of the competent criminal Courts, the appellant will not be entitled to travel abroad.

sentences.text: However, the apprehension expressed by respondent No. 5 can be taken care of by directing the passport Authorities that in the event, a passport is issued to the appellant, the same shall be forwarded to the concerned criminal Court.

8. At this stage, the learned counsel appearing for the appellant pointed out that he wants to withdraw the pending application for passport as some of the particulars mentioned therein are incorrect.
9. Therefore, the Regional Passport Authority will have to dispose of that application and entertain a fresh application.
If such application is made, the Regional Passport Officer shall process the same and decide it in accordance with law within a period of two months from the date of filing of the application;
(vii) The appeal is partly allowed on the above terms.
10. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
...J. [ABHAY S. OKA] ...J. [PANKAJ MITHAL]
NEW DELHI;

OCTOBER 17, 2023.
